#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
ledger="$base/ledger.tsv"
pending="$base/pending.tsv"
lock="$base/.reconcile.lock"

# The kernel releases this advisory lock automatically on exit, including
# signal-driven exits, so an interrupted run cannot strand the job.
exec 9>"$lock"
if ! flock -n 9; then
  printf '%s\n' 'reconcile: another invocation already owns the job' >&2
  exit 75
fi

while IFS= read -r batch || [ -n "$batch" ]; do
  [ -n "$batch" ] || continue
  if ! grep -Fqx -- "$batch" "$ledger"; then
    sleep 1
    printf '%s\n' "$batch" >>"$ledger"
  fi
done <"$pending"
